subject:

messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: GDPR DPA & SCC selection (next steps)

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the GDPR / DPA work:

Summary from our discovery:
- Acme will act as the Controller; Redwood will act as the Processor.
- Primary data flow: customer-submitted product data (PII) processed by Redwood inference services in us-west and eu-west regions.
- Regulatory ask: Acme needs a signed DPA and Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) for controller-to-processor flows.
- Other security items: Acme asked about SOC 2 status and whether we can support HIPAA (BAA).

What I attached: Redwood_DPA_v3.docx (our standard DPA) and an SCC_selection_table.pdf with our recommendation. Our legal recommendation is to use the EU Commission SCCs (controller -> processor) — i.e., Module 2/controller-to-processor flow — with the standard DPA riders.

Answers to your questions:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified; I included the SOC 2 certificate link in the Drive folder.
- HIPAA: We can support HIPAA-sensitive workloads via our Private deployment and are open to a BAA — I'll loop legal to confirm the exact terms.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm that Acme will proceed with controller -> processor SCCs (module 2) and if you prefer any specific variant/annex from your legal team.
2) If yes, review the attached DPA and send back any high-level redlines or markups (DocuSign is fine).
3) I'll kick off our vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) and pull in Rishi (legal) to handle any DPA redlines.

If that works, I’ll schedule a short sync next week with our legal team. Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.inference/

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the DPA. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed: Acme is the Controller, Redwood is the Processor. We do require the controller-to-processor SCCs.
- Prefer: the EU Commission SCCs for controller->processor. If your SCC_selection_table maps to Module 2, that aligns with our legal team's preference.
- SOC 2: Good to hear you’re Type II certified; please share the certificate and the last audit date.
- HIPAA: We aren’t planning HIPAA workloads in phase 1, but it’s helpful to know you support a BAA path for future work.

Next steps from our side:
- Legal will review Redwood_DPA_v3 and come back with any redlines (likely within 5 business days).
- Can you start the VSQ? Our procurement will need the questionnaire to complete the PO.

Thanks — Jamie
